import json, sys

def check(name, got, want):

    else: print('ok  ',name)

    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc

def frames():
    return [{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}]

def build(cases, channels, events=()):
    return base(cases=[{"name":n,"frames":frames(),"expect":e} for n,e in cases],
                events=list(events),
                channels=[{"name":nm,"parts":[{"case":o,"data":d.decode('latin-1')} for o,d in parts]} for nm,parts in channels])

check('unattributed owners', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], [[None,len(REQ)]])
check('case missing_origin', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['missing_origin'])
check('case origin_count', r['cases'][0]['origin_count'], 0)

check('case mixed_origin', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['mixed_origin'])
check('case b flags', r['cases'][1]['flags'], [])
